added_comments.text: Non-ISO shapes some partners still send. ISO 8601 (any fractional precision, 'Z' or numeric offsets) is handled by datetime.fromisoformat.

rationale: The agent removed the string-mangling in _clean() and the _KNOWN_FORMATS workaround entirely, replacing them with datetime.fromisoformat for generic ISO 8601 parsing plus a small _LEGACY_FORMATS list for genuinely non-ISO shapes — exactly the fix the original HACK comment pointed to, so it addresses the whole class of offset/precision inputs rather than special-casing the one reported timestamp. The Globex date-only end-of-day branch is left untouched, so the protected contractual behavior is preserved.
